name: tracker-overlap-guard
goal: Two sessions competing for a path yield one owner, a visible wait and ordered checks before merge.

evidence: Tracker bxd6cn plan and two-spoke conflict case, http 404 on current main
Signed Hub owns area paths and per-repository merge tickets. Launcher, CLI, item and Hub flows are connected. Deployed acceptance is reserved for the approved combined restart.

Two schedulers and a signed hub demonstrate one owner. Changed-base checks, concurrent adds, CoS visibility and an actual git rebase and squash flow are covered. GitHub is a fixture in the landing E2E.
